meta.name: communicate
meta.description: Draft a professional communication (Slack, email, or async doc) with context from the vault

copy.tagline: 根据笔记内容起草专业沟通信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从笔记中提取信息快速撰写工作沟通内容
copy.tagline_en: Draft professional communications using vault context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly compose work communications based on your notes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的信息和收件人，从知识库中读取相关会议记录、决策笔记和人员偏好，然后按渠道（Slack、邮件、异步文档）和受众（工程、设计、领导、客户）调整语气和格式，生成可直接复制使用的专业沟通草稿。
howto.when: 当你需要撰写工作沟通（如更新、通知、汇报）并指定收件人和渠道时触发。

say.text: 给工程团队写一条 Slack 消息，更新 API 范围变更。
say.note: Claude 会读取相关笔记并生成 Slack 格式草稿。

say.text: 给领导层写一封邮件，汇报 Q1 进展。
say.note: Claude 会生成战略导向、指标驱动的邮件正文。

howto.what_en: Claude reads relevant meeting notes, decisions, and recipient preferences from the vault, then drafts a professional communication (Slack, email, or async doc) with tone and format tailored to the audience (engineering, design, leadership, customers).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to draft a work communication (e.g., update, announcement, report) and specify the recipient and channel.

say_en.text: Draft a Slack message for engineering about API scope change.
say_en.note: Claude reads notes and produces Slack-formatted draft.

say_en.text: Write an email to leadership on Q1 progress.
say_en.note: Claude generates a strategic, metrics-driven email.
